units.translation: for the wicked faring well are not to be endured
and now up to this day the god inclines well
of those who have met with good fortune
for know this well and clearly
the trial of such a man must be well guarded against
and we judge that it is well for you to accomplish these things in every way
since he well commands the army
for I will set the affairs of my masters well when they have fallen
you have well advised me in this, not least
and this good thing, my gain, increases
the counsels of the people of the land have been well decreed to be complete (Heimsoethius probably changes δήμου to λαῶν)
I prepare to address the gods well
having obtained well of the mind
for to those who appear well, well may be an addition
for it has been done well
for the aged always have youth to learn well
guiding the helm of the mind well
a kindly toil for those who have accomplished well
so that it may remain well for a long time
for he does not speak well
grant well to see (I corrected ἀναδῦν) the house of the man
and your strength is sufficient to do well
the terrible thing must remain well and as overseer of the mind (thus the anonymous of Dobree for δειμαίνει) seated
honoring well the reverence of parents
so that justice may be well decided
if the god grants (thus Schuetz for Διός) well and truly
you understand well, O earth, the foreign speech
and from on high may he hear well when called
and he sent well, and may he receive well in the land
so that this matter may turn out well for you
and may it be well contrary to my judgment
avert the insolence of the man, having hated it well
thus may the city be well governed
who released Io from her sufferings, holding her well with healing hand
for no one who has stumbled seems to have planned well
what of these is well, what without evils?
and may the good be victorious
having been fortunate, having fared well: see under κυρέω
and this good thing, my gain, increases
when the dark fire appeared as a messenger of good news
you sacrifice with hopes of good news
a messenger of good news indeed – may he come
and by the fire of good news
and coming as a messenger of good news of deliverance
Said of a bright place from which a view extends widely over the neighborhood.
